title: Shinonome Akito — The View From Up Above〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Airport

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've finally arrived! In the United States of America!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'll take a photo and send it to my dad to let him know that we've made it over safely!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good call! I'll do the same!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, quit acting like we're at an amusement park. Have you let Taiga's manager know that we're arrived?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, when we were at baggage claim.
I'm still waiting to hear back from him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hear that, Toya?
You get to rest for a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's been a little while now since we got off the plane, but you still don't look that great. How are you feeling?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't buy that. Quit the tough-guy act.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We can sit down over there, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's even a shop right next to it, so why don't we all grab some drinks and have a seat?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, you guys watch our bags!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem.
se_walk_women_002_2
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
This is gonna be our first American shopping experience!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! I hope we're able to put our lessons to good use.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here, Toya, have a seat.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm glad we had a smooth flight, huh.
A little turbulence can make an airplane shake a lot, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Like a roller coaster...
Actually, it might be worse than that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Compared to that, I think we got off fairly lightly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I basically fell asleep after watching just one movie.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How about you? Get any sleep?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Only a little...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess anyone would have trouble sleeping when they're feeling as tense as you were.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, you clung to your seat's armrests like your life depended on it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, during takeoff in particular.
I felt that I had to hold on tight or else...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I also feel bad for hogging it.
I'm sure you would've also liked to use it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but I didn't mind letting you use it during takeoff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I knew he'd have a rough time with his fear of heights, but I didn't think it'd affect him this much...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After the plane took off, he closed his eyes and refused to look towards any of the windows.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The flight home probably isn't gonna be any easier. I just hope that it goes smoothly...)
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're back! With drinks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thanks.
So, did you actually speak in English at the counter?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Touche.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Uncle Taiga's manager just got back to me! He says he's really close by...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Close by?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, he said we'll probably know who he is, so we should come find him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What?
But we've never met him before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, wait. Over there. That has to be him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Where?
How did you know who to look for?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The person over by the exit.
He's holding a sign that says, “WELCOME! Vivid BAD SQUAD!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He's right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I think he noticed us!
Let's grab our bags...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You okay to walk, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I should be fine now.
I feel a little better after sitting down...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's good to hear...
Then, let's go over to where the manager is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem.
